name: Critical SCADA Recovery
author: Lin
description: The main strategic goal was to prevent operational downtime at a major oil sands facility by rapidly stabilizing a failing SCADA monitoring system before production and safety operations were impacted.

strategy: The main strategic goal was to prevent operational downtime at a major oil sands facility by rapidly stabilizing a failing SCADA monitoring system before production and safety operations were impacted.
workPlan: The technical challenge was caused by intermittent failures in the SCADA communication and synchronization services, which led to delayed operational data, inconsistent equipment status reporting, and the risk of losing real-time monitoring visibility for critical plant systems.
people: The most visible and influential individual was the senior infrastructure engineer, who led the technical response by diagnosing the synchronization failures, coordinating the recovery plan across teams, and overseeing the safe deployment of the system stabilization patch without disrupting plant operations.
operations: The IT operations team supported the SCADA recovery by maintaining system availability, monitoring server and network performance, coordinating secure remote access, and managing deployment and rollback procedures throughout the incident. Their coordination ensured the recovery could be implemented quickly and safely while minimizing operational risk and preventing disruption to live plant operations.
results: The primary KPI was the restoration of full real-time SCADA monitoring stability within four hours, with zero production downtime or safety-system interruptions during the incident. This directly supported the organization’s goals of maintaining operational reliability, protecting production revenue, and ensuring continuous safety visibility across the facility.
